_note: Donations allowed at half: "an amount equal to 50% of the aggregate of the sums paid as donation by an assessee during the tax year to" s.133(1)(b)(i) the Prime Minister's Drought Relief Fund, without limit, and (ii)–(vi) — a registered or approved charitable fund or institution, the Government or a local authority for a charitable purpose other than family planning, a housing or town-planning authority, a notified minority-community corporation, an entity repairing a notified place — within s.133(2)'s qualifying limit (p.169); Income-tax Rules, 2026 Form No. 114 note 5 (p.2217): "Donor shall be eligible for deduction of 50% of the donation made subject to 10% of adjusted gross total income as per section 133(2)". Base AMOUNT_PAID, the sum counted. A (b)(ii) donation is allowed only on the donee's report (s.133(6)). Old regime only: s.202(2)(a)(xii) excludes Chapter VIII other than ss.124(1), 124(2), 125(2) and 146 (p.227). TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26; the 1961 counterpart, s.80G, is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d5). rulebook DED-80G-001. D-142. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80G(1) (thc p.348): "plus fifty per cent of the balance of such aggregate" ((i)), "fifty per cent of the aggregate" ((ii)) — half of every sum not on the whole list: (a)(iii) the Prime Minister's Drought Relief Fund without limit; (a)(iv), (v), (vi), (via) and (b) within s.80G(4)'s limit. sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B24, B25. D-148. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, whose basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (S2 s.202(2)(a); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i)) every explanation cites (D-166). The row reaches a donation by its clause (donation.clause): DROUGHT_RELIEF_FUND, CHARITABLE_INSTITUTION and PUBLIC_BODY, the s.133(1)(b) donees (W-156a, D-344).
